version.promotionalText: Private cadet rosters, event photo search, clearer match ranges, reliable previews, saved finds, family notes, and a plain-English academy terms guide.
version.description:
CadetCatch helps Coast Guard Academy families keep up with cadet photos without digging through every gallery by hand.

Create a private roster on your iPhone, add a clear cadet photo, search event photos for possible matches, review likely finds, save photos to your iPhone Photos library, and keep simple notes for family follow-up.

CadetCatch shows possible matches for you to review. For best results, use a clear photo where only your cadet is visible.

Privacy Policy: https://eb28.co/cc/privacy/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
version.whatsNew: CadetCatch build 95 keeps the paid access gate, adds account email controls for future desktop and family sharing access, keeps the approved $12.99 Family Monthly subscription path, and preserves the server photo search and reliable matched-photo previews.

notes: No login is required for the core iPhone photo search flow.
Add a cadet profile from Roster using a clear photo selected from Photos.
Open Info to review the parent-facing photo matching guidance.
Open Home and tap Search Photos. The app sends the selected cadet photo for matching, shows loading state, and then displays possible matches returned by CadetCatch.
Open Photos to review possible matches, view a photo, save it to the iPhone Photos library, save it in the app, and create a family note.

Open Photo Access from More or a locked photo. The monthly subscription screen shows Family Monthly, 1 month, the monthly price, auto-renewal text, Restore Purchases, Privacy Policy, and Terms of Use (EULA) before purchase.
Open More > Account & Desktop to see the account email field and the spouse/cadet invite slots. These features require the CadetCatch access API before production use.
If no face, multiple faces, no matches, or a connection problem occurs, the app shows a clear state instead of showing unrelated results.

parent-facing photo matching guidance in Info

knownRisks: Matched photo previews bypass stale photo URL cache entries so recovered R2 photo URLs can load after previously returning 404.
Matched photos load from the photo_url returned by CadetCatch. The current service may return public R2 development URLs while photos.cadetcatch.com is finalized.
Event photo collection and matching are handled by CadetCatch service infrastructure, not by private accounts on the phone.
In-app purchase products must be active in App Store Connect before TestFlight purchase flows can return live products.
Access codes require a server-validated entitlement system before production use; hardcoded free-access codes must not be shipped in the app.
The current production access API endpoints for desktop and invite status must be deployed and verified before App Review submission.
The access API source now includes Apple App Store Server API verification for Family Monthly subscription links, but it has not been deployed to api.cadetcatch.com yet.
